description: Launch the browser with a persistent profile (headed by default; pass headless:true for headless). With cdp_port: attach to a Chromium/Electron app started by this server's mac_app launch cdp_port (needs NORACU_ALLOW_CDP=1; attaching to any other loopback port needs NORACU_ALLOW_CDP=any; refused under NORACU_READ_ONLY=1 and while another session is open; standalone browser_launch is also refused while a CDP session is open). browser_close then only disconnects. With chrome:true: work in your own Chrome, with its sign-ins (needs NORACU_ALLOW_CHROME=1 and Chrome's remote debugging switched on at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging; Chrome asks you to allow the connection). noracu opens a window of its own there and lists, reads and acts only on the tabs it opened (and tabs those open) — with NORACU_CHROME_TABS=all on the server, on your other tabs too (http(s) pages); browser_close closes only noracu's tabs and disconnects, and Chrome keeps running.
name: browser_launch
